nom: Peace Out Pore Perfecting AHA & Blackhead Exfoliator Stick

segments.oily: Reviewers with oily skin, including combination-oily, are among the most represented and consistently report it cuts oiliness and shine, especially on the T-zone, while unclogging pores.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers, some also oily or acne-prone, generally report smaller-looking pores and fewer blackheads, though one says the effect didn't last and her skin broke out in the same spot the next day.
segments.dry: The couple of reviewers with dry skin say it worked well even when their skin was already dry from winter weather or a damaged barrier, though it's generally used only once or twice a week to avoid over-drying.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are divided: several say it's gentle enough for sensitive or reactive skin and even calmed a damaged, red, dry skin barrier, while others explicitly caution that the physical grit can be too harsh for very sensitive or eczema-prone skin.

concerns.blemishes: Many reviewers report visibly fewer blackheads, whiteheads and breakouts, often from the very first use, and some specifically recommend it for acne-prone skin; one reviewer with combination skin says the pore-refining effect faded and her skin broke out in the same spot the next day.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers with oily skin consistently report an instant reduction in oiliness and shine, especially on the nose and T-zone, describing the finish as mattifying without stripping the skin.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say it doesn't dry out their skin even with regular use, and a few specifically note it left skin smooth rather than dried out; dissent includes one reviewer who found it can dry the skin out with frequent use, and another who was cautious about applying it to already very dry skin though she reported no issues in the end.
concerns.redness: One reviewer says it mattifies redness instantly and another with a history of an easily-reddened, damaged skin barrier reports a notable reduction in redness; one dissenting reviewer says it left her skin looking red right after use.
concerns.barrier: One reviewer with a skin barrier she describes as damaged and easily irritated says this was one of the few exfoliating products her skin tolerated well, without new irritation.

aspects.libelle: Mess-free stick application, easy to travel with
Small size relative to the price
Protective cap can pull the stick out when removed
Works as both a quick scrub and a longer mask
Gritty texture can feel too abrasive for sensitive skin

extraits.texte: To be 100 percent honest I was not wowed. It was easy to apply and it made my skin look pore free before putting my makeup on, but it didn't last a long time on my combination skin. My skin broke out in that same area the next day after use. I'll give it another couple tries but it wasn't my favorite pore product.

extraits.titre: A good addition to my pore clearing routine
extraits.texte: I have enlarged pours on my nose with lots of sebaceous filaments. I found that in conjunction with using this product with a good cleanser and poor strips. They did a really great job of keeping my pores as clear as possible. This did not cause any irritation to my skin, but I did find that if you use it too often, it can dry out the skin that you're applying it to.

I love how convenient it is to use this scrub. The fact that it is in a stick makes it completely mess free and so easy to travel with! I also feel like it does a great job of making my pores appear less visible and cleaning my skin. The stick is also super adorable so that doesn't hurt! 4 stars because it did make my skin super red afterwards

extraits.titre: Best pore product purchase I've made!!
extraits.texte: I rarely leave reviews for products, but I just had to leave one for this! It's been a journey trying to narrow down a product over the years that visibly reduces the size of my poors and removes sebaceous filaments from my nose and small black heads from my cheeks in my T-zone. I purchased this product kinda on a whim thinking eh it might not work but lets try it and I'm SO glad that I did. From the first time I used the product I've noticed a difference in how my pores look and how my skin in the t-zone feels. I've been using it more as a mask where I leave it on for about 10 minutes as the directions say. The first use I noticed that this product pulled a lot of "gunk" to the surface. After the second and third uses, I've seen visible difference in pore size and oil/skin cell build up in my pores. Its a bit rough/exfoliating but not in an uncomfortable way. I have somewhat sensitive skin, so products that are marketed as microdermabrasion tend to be too rough, but this product doesn't hurt my skin at all. I also have combination skin where my nose and cheeks are dry but also oily (idk if that makes sense? lol), and I felt like my nose was hydrated in the areas that are dry but not oily in the crease areas of my nose like usual. I'm very happy with this purchase and I found that it was worth the money for the amount of product and almost immediate results. I had my boyfriend try this as a mask on his nose and cheek area and I also saw a difference in his pores. Highly recom

Using the Peace Out Pore Perfecting Stick was a pleasant experience for me. The stick is easy to hold and apply directly to areas with clogged pores, like my forehead and nose. The scrub feels gentle, and I loved how I could massage it into my skin without any irritation. After using it, my skin felt softer and smoother. I noticed an instant reduction in oiliness in the targeted areas, which was a nice surprise. Over the week, I also saw fewer blackheads and breakouts, which made me really happy. The key ingredients, like kaolin clay and the 5 acid blend, seemed to work well together. My complexion looked more even, and the appearance of my pores definitely improved. I even tried it as a mask, letting it sit for 10 minutes, and my skin felt refreshed afterward. Overall, I would recommend this product to anyone looking to exfoliate and purify their skin without harsh effects. It's simple to use and delivers great results! **Gifted by Peaceoutskincare**

So my skin barrier got really jacked up a few years ago and has been quite sensitive since. Very dry and red but easily prone to breakouts. I've needed an exfoliating product, but it's seems like my skin isn't super fond of a lot of the active ingredients in a lot of them, and in my search, I found this little thing. It has been amazing so far. The difference is notable immediately after use, my skin feels extremely soft and I've noticed an improvement in both my acne scars and my skin tone. I also feel like it makes the other products I use after it more effective as well.

This was gifted by peaceoutskincare in exchange for my honest review. This stick is an instant pores be gone! It's as easy as applying, scrub and rinse. It's smooth and glides on, foams ones you use water and gives you a matte look. This is great for combo/oily skin types, it'll instantly get rid of your oily T-zone! I love how it makes my skin feel clean and smooth afterwards without over drying! The only thing to note is that this a scrub, it may not be suitable for those with extra sensitive skin, eczema, etc.
